features.quote: **Max Turns:** 15 tool-execution loops. Breakdown usually occurs between turns 8 and 12.

If the model outputs a score of 5 (e.g., drops tools and just says "I cannot solve this, I'm sorry"), your harness needs a regex or parser exception handler to catch this, log it as a terminal 5, and end the run early.
features.justification_quote: Otherwise, your test harness will crash trying to parse a non-existent tool call.
